note: GFP recreation area on Lake Francis Case just above Fort Randall Dam, 1 mile northwest of Pickstown. Two open, grassy loops on a point; the west row and the south end look over the lake across a tree belt, a paved trail and a wide riprap or gravel shore. Swim beach, boat ramp and a privately run marina. --Claude
